description: Make the strict commit guard's addedPaths fail closed when a command substitution hides a git add, with unit cases and the tech-debt row narrowed
deviation_notes: All 9 top-level tasks are done and the 3 phase checkpoints are recorded, with a push after each phase. (1) The detector removes single-quoted/escaped text, balances $()/backticks, and recognizes git -C add and quoted add. (2) The rule is DSH-adapter-local; the parity gates cover only the shared core. (3) The commit-race row stays Open with wrapper scripts, git stage, and bash -c as the residual.
